systems.system: système informatisé de suivi de la situation financière des communes
systems.country_label: système informatisé de suivi de la situation financière de chaque commune
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Spatial Planning
systems.tiers: four levels: commune, daira, central administration; in service from 11 December 2022

note: The system tracks each commune's month-end cash, spending and collection level through the communal treasuries; it is a finance-monitoring (accounts) system, no payer register or local-staff revenue entry stated.
